## Operational problem

Describe the failure mode, missing guidance, or operator decision this change addresses.

## Change

Explain the resulting procedure and the affected runbooks.

## Validation

State exactly what was checked, the environment used, and the observed result. Distinguish a documentation review from an executed recovery drill. If commands were not run, say so.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Placeholders and relative links are consistent.
- [ ] Commands are clearly identified as read-only or state-changing.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or private infrastructure details are included.
- [ ] Recovery claims state measurement boundaries and limitations.
- [ ] Actual collaborators are credited accurately in commit trailers.
